evidence_gaps: No fresh runtime forensics branch or evidence file available (evidence_status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS).
Lack of historical strategy-specific performance data (opportunities, eligible opportunities, wins, losses, profit factor) in the strategy_lab_windows table.
Lack of real-time transaction records or execution logs to measure actual slippage, priority fees, and transaction failure rates under fast market conditions.
Lack of real-time Jupiter/Raydium pricing query adapter for Solana leader events to calculate active gross edge, liquidity, and sellability.

proposals.downside_risk: Reduces total eligible opportunity count for the Dislocation Mean Reversion family by filtering out positive dislocation events.

evidence.detail: Line 164 evaluates absolute dislocation: abs(_d(features.dislocation_z)) < Decimal('1.5') rather than restricting triggers to negative dislocation (underpricing) for directional long spot entry.

proposals.expected_effect: Eliminates economically unsound buy triggers on overvalued assets, reducing downside risk in strong momentum-extension environments.
proposals.rationale: A long-only directional spot strategy can only profit from buying undervalued assets. Evaluating absolute dislocation means the bot may buy overvalued assets (dislocation_z > 1.5) expecting them to reversion-drop, causing immediate losses upon buy.
proposals.shadow_test: Run a parallel shadow simulator for Dislocation Mean Reversion comparing the absolute z-score strategy vs the negative-only z-score strategy over 7 days. Stop the test if simulation drawdown on mock capital exceeds 5%.

proposals.downside_risk: Increased Solana RPC request overhead, potential API rate-limiting, and minor latency addition to the main loop.

evidence.detail: Lines 269-277 shows Solana leader events lack active executable future quotes, causing gross_edge_bps, liquidity, and sellability to remain defaulted to zero.

proposals.expected_effect: Enables Solana leader signals to be successfully evaluated by the 7 strategy families in the Strategy Lab.
proposals.rationale: Because Solana feature adaptation lacks contemporaneous quotes, its opportunities fail the platform-wide common executability thresholds. Integrating an RPC/Jupiter price fetcher is required to calculate genuine executable edge.
proposals.shadow_test: Deploy a mock/read-only Solana quote adapter querying Jupiter Price API on leader swap events, measuring latency and percentage of successfully populated features over 5 days. Terminate if RPC query latency exceeds 800ms.

proposals.downside_risk: Reduces the volume of eligible opportunities in the New Liquidity Quality family.

evidence.detail: Line 197-198 allows pool age up to 86400 seconds (24 hours) for new pools.

proposals.expected_effect: Improves strategy safety and lowers the probability of purchasing dying/rugged tokens.
proposals.rationale: A 24-hour window is too wide for new liquidity pools. High-risk rugpulls, honeypots, and sudden liquidity drains occur most frequently during initial hours of pool launch. Restricting the evaluation window to the first 4 hours (14,400 seconds) focuses the strategy on fresh, active listings and mitigates stale-honeypot risk.
proposals.shadow_test: Run shadow evaluation on New Liquidity Quality comparing a 4-hour pool age threshold vs a 24-hour threshold over 10 days, recording simulated rugpull losses. Terminate if simulated loss exceeds 10%.

rejected_ideas.idea: Direct promotion of EVM Cross Venue Net Arbitrage to Canary lane
rejected_ideas.reason: Prohibited by core safety guidelines due to the complete lack of fresh within-2h runtime forensics. Promoting any strategy directly without verified out-of-sample shadow stats is a high-risk violation of the Strategy Lab lifecycle.

rejected_ideas.idea: Broadening the liquidity score threshold in _common_executable to artificially increase trade frequency
rejected_ideas.reason: Violates the core mandate that active does not mean forced trading. Artificially lowering safety/liquidity gates to force trades turns activity targets into loss-generating quotas.

summary: Completed a comprehensive architecture-only strategic review. Due to missing runtime forensics, no strategy is promoted to canary/live lanes. Identified three major improvement areas: restricting Dislocation Mean Reversion to negative-only dislocations for long-only spot-buys, developing an active quote/price adapter for Solana leader events to bypass the current fail-closed zero-value default, and tightening the New Liquidity Quality pool age window from 24 hours to 4 hours to lower rugpull exposure.
